BiblicalUsage: Mesheq is possession, the steward of a house, the one who holds what belongs to another. Genesis 15:2 has Abram say, Lord GOD, what wilt Thou give me, seeing I go childless, and the steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus?
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Abram's complaint is the prayer of every childless believer: the house is full, but the heir is missing, and only God can fill it.
